verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents on-demand model loading: sending an inference request to a model that is not yet loaded loads it before the request returns, so models can be switched on a running server. `lms load` with a custom `--identifier` lets models be loaded into the running server by name, separately from `lms server start/stop`. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that several models stay loaded at once, a documented CLI/API unload command or eviction/TTL behavior, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching models without a restart.
